*Pītittika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 17.26) is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka. As part of the combinatorial analytical matrices characteristic of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text examines conditional relations at the intersection of the triad of rapture (*pītittika*) and the triad of wholesome states (*kusalattika*) [DharmaNexus].

 However, computational analysis by DharmaNexus identifies substantial Pali-internal text reuse typical of the formulaic structure of the *Paṭṭhāna*, with 92 matching passages shared across 34 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The largest textual alignments occur with other sections of the *Paṭṭhāna*, notably *Kusalattika, Tika* (Patthana 5.1, sharing §0.3–3.1 with §97.0.1–99.1), *Tika Hetuduka* (Patthana 4.1), *Pītittika* (Patthana 1.8), *Tika Saraṇaduka* (Patthana 4.8), *Tika Kusalattika* (Patthana 5.2), and related cross-triad formulations such as *Vedanāttika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 17.21) and *Hetuduka, Pītittika* (Patthana 15.7) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus reports no cross-language matches meeting the significance threshold [DharmaNexus].
